00.name: Sour
00.text: I can't believe you gave up your axe.

drop_1.name: Sweat
drop_1.text: It was the right thing to do.

drop_2.name: Sour
drop_2.text: But it made us look like pushovers.

drop_3.name: Sweat
drop_3.text: That doesn't matter. Only the quest matters.

drop_4.name: Lumberjack
drop_4.text: Look. It was my choice to give up my axe. I don't know why your so upset.

drop_5.name: Sour
drop_5.text: I'm upset because your choices just seem to be whatever Sweat tells you to do.

drop_6.name: Sweat
drop_6.text: Following my guidance isn't a bad trait to have.

drop_7.name: Sour
drop_7.text: It is when your guidance is terrible.

drop_8.name: Lumberjack
drop_8.text: If I knew this quest had so much squabbling in it I would have never accepted it. Oh wait, I didn't get a choice.

drop_9.name: Sour
drop_9.text: Don't give us backchat lumberer. Most people would give anything up to recieve a quest from lord Pasta.

drop_10.name: Sweat
drop_10.text: You should count yourself lucky mortal. And try to appreciate how lucky you are before deciding to talk back to us.

drop_11.name: Lumberjack
drop_11.text: Don't feel too lucky. I just gave up my main source of income for this quest. Better be worth it.

fight_0.name: Sweat
fight_0.text: There was no reason to fight.

fight_1.name: Sour
fight_1.text: Uh. We had every reason to fight. That big oak was blocking our path. The lumberer just did his job and removed the road block.

fight_2.name: Sweat
fight_2.text: We can't just endanger the quest like that. Especially when we have a safer alternative.

fight_3.name: Sour
fight_3.text: So what, you want the lumberer to give up his axe. What would he be without it.

fight_4.name: Sweat
fight_4.text: The mortal would have been a whole lot smarter if he gave up his axe.

fight_5.name: Lumberjack
fight_5.text: Can you two stop arguing for like five minutes. Your starting to sound like a pair of hyenas.

fight_7.name: Sour
fight_7.text: You aren't here to give us your opinion, your here to carry the relic. So less backhanded chit chat and more marching.

fight_8.name: Lumberjack
fight_8.text: What did I ever do to deserve this.

01.name: Narrator
01.text: Leaving the forest behind, you walk along the trail in silence until you come to another fork in the road. One trail leads to the left another to the right.

last_right_3.name: Sour
last_right_3.text: Left. We went right last time and we ended up being blocked by a fallen tree. So, this time we go left.

last_right_4.name: Sweat
last_right_4.text: No. We go right again. Sure we got blocked by the tree but how was I supposed to know that it had fallen onto the trail. I know which way to go and that way is right.

last_right_8.name: Sweat
last_right_8.text: Argh. Forget it. Mortal you decide.

last_right_9.name: Sour
last_right_9.text: What. The lumberer is just going to decide with you again like they did with the last fork in the road and the talking tree.

last_right_10.name: Sour
last_right_10.text: What. The lumberer is just going to decide with you again like they did with the last fork in the road.

last_right_11.name: Sweat
last_right_11.text: To bad. I say right you say left, the mortals vote will break the tie.

last_right_12.name: Sour
last_right_12.text: Alright just don't be swayed to pick right just because it worked out fine last time. Remember how tired you were after chopping that tree and Sweat made you keep walking.

last_left_0.name: Sweat
last_left_0.text: Ok. So we're definitely going right this time.

last_left_1.name: Sour
last_left_1.text: What why. I say we go left again.

last_left_2.name: Sweat
last_left_2.text: Last time we went left we got lost. This time we're going to take the right path.

last_left_3.name: Sour
last_left_3.text: No way. We were never lost we just took a detour. I don't see any reason why we don't just go left again. Lumberer you decide.

last_left_4.name: Sweat
last_left_4.text: Why ask the mortal. Just so they can agree with you again like how they agreed to go left last time and fight the forest guardian.

last_left_5.name: Sweat
last_left_5.text: Why ask the mortal. Just so they can agree with you again like how they agreed to go left last time.

last_left_6.name: Sour
last_left_6.text: To bad, let the lumberer decide.

last_left_7.name: Sweat
last_left_7.text: Please mortal I beg you don't be stupid.
